Article 6.5: Account Inactivity Policy

Warren's summary

Every FFN account must complete at least 3 qualifying trading days within every 29-day rolling period to remain active, where a qualifying trading day closes with a realized profit or loss of at least $5. Accounts that do not meet this requirement are automatically cancelled with no warning or manual review, and this rule applies to all accounts including blown accounts. If inactivity cancellation leaves you with no remaining accounts, your platform access and Rithmic data feed are disabled. You can rejoin FFN at any time by logging into your Dashboard, going to Add Account, and purchasing a new account, which automatically re-enables your access.

Overview

Every FFN account must remain active through regular trading. To keep and maintain an account, a trader must complete a minimum number of qualifying trading days within each 29-day period. Accounts that fall short are automatically cancelled. This article explains how trading days are counted, the minimum requirement, what happens when a user runs out of accounts, and how to reactivate access.

What Counts as a Qualifying Trading Day

A trading day counts toward the minimum only when it closes with a realized profit or loss of at least $5. Simply logging in, placing and cancelling orders, or leaving the platform open does not count. Multiple trades on the same calendar day still count as a single trading day; the day qualifies as long as the day's net result is a profit or loss of $5 or more.

Minimum Trading Days Requirement (29-Day Rule)

To keep and maintain your account, you must complete at least 3 qualifying trading days within every 29-day period. If an account does not record 3 qualifying trading days within a 29-day period, it is automatically cancelled.

A qualifying trading day is any day the account closes with a realized profit or loss of at least $5.
You need at least 3 qualifying trading days in each rolling 29-day period.
Cancellation is automatic. No warning is required and no manual review is performed.
Blown Accounts Are Included

The requirement applies to all accounts, including blown (failed) accounts. Because a blown account cannot record qualifying trading days, a blown account left idle for 29 days is automatically deleted along with any active account.

WARNING: Do not assume a blown account is exempt. A blown account that goes 29 days without meeting the minimum trading-day requirement is permanently deleted just like any other inactive account.

NOTE: Funded accounts can be identified by their account number, which begins with 2DF, EPS, EPV, or 7PV.

What Happens When You Have No Accounts Left

If inactivity cancellation leaves a user with no remaining accounts, that user's data and platform licenses are disabled. This includes access to the trading platform and the Rithmic data feed.

How to Reactivate Your Access

A disabled user can rejoin FFN at any time. There is no separate reinstatement request.

Log in to your FFN Dashboard.
Go to the Add Account section.
Purchase a new account.

Once the new account is purchased, your user profile is automatically re-enabled so you can use your trading platform and Rithmic data feed again.

Examples
Idle funded account: You pass an evaluation and get funded, then trade only once. If a 29-day period passes without 3 qualifying trading days (each closing with a $5+ profit or loss), the funded account is cancelled.
Idle blown account: Your account blows and you leave it alone. After 29 days without the minimum 3 qualifying trading days, the blown account is automatically deleted.
Last account cancelled: Your only remaining account is cancelled for inactivity. Your data and platform licenses are disabled. To return, log in to your dashboard and buy a new account under Add Account, and your access is restored automatically after purchase.
Frequently Asked Questions

How many days do I need to trade to keep my account?
At least 3 qualifying trading days within every 29-day period.

What makes a trading day count?
The day must close with a realized profit or loss of at least $5. Logging in or placing and cancelling orders does not count.

Does the requirement apply to blown accounts?
Yes. A blown account that goes 29 days without the minimum 3 qualifying trading days is automatically deleted.

What happens to my platform and data feed if all my accounts are cancelled?
Your data and platform licenses are disabled, including your Rithmic data feed.

Can I still come back after being disabled?
Yes. Log in to your FFN Dashboard, go to the Add Account section, and purchase a new account. Your access is re-enabled automatically once the purchase completes.

How do I avoid inactivity cancellation?
Complete at least 3 qualifying trading days, each with a $5 or greater profit or loss, on each account within every 29-day period.
